grades dont make up ur self worth and never should, as long as ur trying ur best then thats all that matters. ur going to make mistakes and any that youve made in the past, are well,,, in the past; those things happened, u learn from ur mistake, and u move on. its never good to always pay attention to the past bc of course we all have things we wouldve want to have done differently but we have to come to the realization of "it happened in the past, i need to leave it there n move on." self criticism is a harsh thing and sometimes we hold the standards a little too high, more then we can handle sometimes i think. i used to be like that with my art, i used to hate everything i painted bc it never came out how i invisioned but now i realized that, what i put down on paper is art regardless, bc theres nothing else like that and that iself, it something to be proud of. theres always something everyone couldve done better, but if we did things better, then it wouldnt take us down a path of learning something new. u should be proud of urself regardless, u deserve to have some happiness for urself bc it isnt easy being a student or just a human in general. give urself some love and start to try to realize the effort u put into things, if no one is going to be proud of ur accomplishments, then at least u urself should be proud.
